svg.title: Bridging over a concave stretch and catching on an obstacle
svg.desc: Schematic normal sections along the yarn direction; the chords are computed as the upper convex hull of the drawn section. Left: the yarn cannot follow a dip and spans it with a bitangent chord. Right: a bulge rises into the free yarn, which catches on it at the tangency point.
svg.text: the yarn spans the dip by the bitangent chord F–F′
the yarn spans the dip by the bitangent chord F–F′
obstacle ahead of the fell point

the free yarn from F catches on the bulge at F′
